ownershipRule: Authored Haxe owns command policy, ordering, consent, and user-visible decisions. A narrow Go facade owns native mechanics. Delegated programs, Dolt, and remote services retain separate ownership.
recipeRule: Every storage command profile has one ordered effect recipe. Effects may be conditional, but omission requires named negative evidence.
